latest.notes: Critical fix: the currently-playing element is never changed by automation — only the queue after it. Removed the drift watchdog that could crossfade off a song mid-play (it mis-read the live log, where aired rows are already removed, as being behind schedule). Recovery still runs, but only when the station is idle: an idle auto-mode station self-heals to the current-time element, and stalls resume at the right time. Nothing on air is ever cut.
